title: Negative evidence is append-only, enforced; approval rules mapped to enforcement points
summary: control_plane.negative_evidence_check enforces the constitution's 'never erase negative evidence': FAIL records and EXP/EVR records with a negative outcome at the base commit cannot be deleted, lose fields or list items, or have text rewritten; appending, status/updated_at changes and growing recurrence counters are allowed. It runs in the validator step (node base commit) and in orchestrate control-check. Mutation score of control_plane.py with its tests: 0.954 (103/108; the 5 survivors are equivalent or message-only). A dogfood test caught that FAIL-0001's legitimate recurrence increase would have been rejected, so recurrence is monotonic. Enforcement map for policy approval_required_for recorded in implementation-status.json: 4 enforced, 1 partial (permission_increase), 1 text-only (external_publication, IMP-0014).
